title: Cloud City: Case Study: TerramEarth — IoT Fleet, Bigtable & Predictive Maintenance
city_concept: City Municipal Cart Fleet & Workshop Sensors

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Twenty thousand city freight wagons were breaking wooden axles on cobblestones without warning, blocking streets for days.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Master Mechanic Martha installed vibration meters on every wagon axle (IoT Sensors) and built two reporting channels: emergency bells (Cellular) and depot inspections (Wi-Fi).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Martha recorded all vibration logs in the Grand Ledger (Bigtable), noticing axles groaned at a specific pitch 2 days before snapping.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Manual mechanical checks take hours per wagon; cloud IoT ingest processes sensor telemetry from 20M vehicles in sub-seconds.
